scope: Length-only policy. NOT a DAPT-ready train split or final downstream cohort.

policy.mlm_candidate: Complete SLICES, <= 512 tokens including special tokens; never truncate.
policy.long_sequences: Quarantine as out-of-scope for original checkpoint; preserve intact for sensitivity analyses.
policy.downstream_candidate: At least 2 eligible structures per composition after length filter; not yet a valid supervised set.
policy.split: Must assign composition-disjoint train/val/test BEFORE MLM. DAPT on train only; test excluded for inductive evaluation.

known_remaining_gates: Validate official SLICES strategy=4 parser/checks against installed version
Verify structural equivalence and canonical composition grouping
Verify energy targets and 0-K polymorph definitions; freeze composition-disjoint split
Audit MLM masking/random replacement & initialize new embeddings
